description: PUMS - Riferimento - Trasporto Ferroviario - Città Metropolitana di Firenze is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogcserver.cittametropolitana.fi.it. The Sustainable Urban Mobility Plan (SUMP) is the strategic document that aims to guide urban mobility policies for the next 10 years.Regional rail transport can make a strategic contribution to the efficiency of the Metropolitan City’s backbone public transport network. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PUMS - Reference - Railway Transport - Metropolitan City of Florence" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, PUMS, geodata. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
